activity.notes: Raoni Metuktire is a living Kayapo/Mẽbêngôkre chief and long-running Indigenous and rainforest campaigner. To avoid inventing an open-ended present-day 'reign', ATLAS records the sharply documented 1989 international campaign as a representative leadership Activity, when Raoni brought Kayapo territorial and environmental concerns to a worldwide audience.

sources.title: Chief Raoni Metuktire — Religions for Peace
sources.citation_text: Religions for Peace identifies Raoni as Chief of the Kayapo People and describes his international campaign beginning with his 1989 overseas tour.

sources.title: We need the trees that give us life — IUCN
sources.citation_text: IUCN identifies Chief Raoni as a revered Indigenous leader who has spent decades campaigning for Indigenous rights and Amazon protection.
